source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The two deletion paths clear Elided and HASCHILDREN for a surviving single-message root but keep ISTHREAD. ReverseThreads uses ISTHREAD to copy whole thread runs, while the inspected IsContainer branch uses HASCHILDREN for threaded row containers. The added visible/hidden deletion tests check root identity and row count across both sort directions. They do not prove SearchDBView behavior or a fresh native result.
title: A single-message thread root keeps its sort-boundary flag after child deletion
